lines.t: The heavens proclaim what no words can contain
The love of the Father, eternal, untamed
It shines through the ages, resplendent and true
The crown of His glory poured out upon you
The love of God, His crowning glory shines
Revealed in the sun, the gift through all time
And we, His beloved, are lifted and crowned
In mercy and grace where forever we're found
The cross is the throne where His kingdom was shown
His glory made known through the love of His own
Through triumph of grace, through the night of His pain
We rise in His victory, sharing His reign
The love of God, His crowning glory shines
Revealed in the Son, the gift through all time
And we, His beloved, are lifted and crowned
In mercy and grace where forever we're found
Oh, crowned with His kindness
Adorned in His fire
The love of the Savior
Our Savior lifts our hearts high
All honor, all praise
To the Lamb who was slain
In glory eternal
He forever reigns
We'll be right back.
The love of God, His crowning glory shines
Revealed in the sun, the gift through all time
And we, His beloved, are lifted and crowned
In the splendor of Yahushua, forever renowned
We'll be right back.
